project_code.label: Project code
project_code.help: Stable site identity; it names the project's physical readings table <code>_vibration_data_daily.

company.label: Company
company.help: Operator-facing identity only; scraping does not read it.

site_name.label: Site name
site_name.help: Human name of the site shown to operators.

timezone.label: Timezone
timezone.help: IANA timezone used to interpret the site's reading times.

config_kind.label: Row kind
config_kind.help: 'site' rows are HALO cards; 'legacy_target' rows are WIRS inputs and are never listed.

enabled.label: Project enabled
enabled.help: Gates scraping: the scraper reads only the source targets of enabled site rows (see supabase/migrate_site_enabled_gates_scraping.sql). A new site is created disabled, so enable it before its first scrape. Disabling stops scraping; the site's readings table and rows stay.

client_id.label: Client ID
client_id.help: Sending-account identifier for the manual site PPV report or legacy diagnostic notification.

instance_name.label: WhatsApp instance
instance_name.help: Listener instance used by the manual site PPV report or legacy diagnostic notification.

lambda_url.label: Send-message URL
lambda_url.help: Listener text endpoint used by the manual site PPV report or legacy diagnostic notification.

wa_group_ids.label: Notification groups
wa_group_ids.help: Groups receiving an explicitly sent site PPV report or legacy diagnostic notification; scraping never messages them.

vibration_formatter.label: Vibration alert format
vibration_formatter.help: Formatter used by automatic PPV threshold alerts. SKW_format is the current alert wording.
